name: Stat strip
summary: Four headline numbers in one band, each with a plain note under it, and a small bar where a share matters.
use: at the top of a dashboard, for its headline numbers
states: wraps to two or one column
a11y: A description list, so each number is read with its label; the bar is decorative and its value is in the text.

use_when: a report or account page that opens with two to four totals before the detail
avoid_when: one number tracked against a limit or goal: use budget-meters or savings-goal
a share of a whole split into parts: use donut-breakdown

parts.name: stats
parts.what: one headline number: label, value and a note

parts.name: value
parts.what: the number, with cents set lighter

parts.name: note
parts.what: one plain line of context, sometimes with a warning word

parts.name: meter
parts.what: a small bar for a share, with the share in words beside it

empty.how: the Smart UI renderer puts one plain 'Nothing to show yet.' line in an empty list

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if a number cannot load, show a dash and put the reason in the note with the warning colour

disabled.how: the strip has no controls, so there is no disabled state

overflow.how: two columns by default, four when the box is wide, and smaller figures on a phone

long_text.how: values never wrap, so keep them short; labels and notes wrap in their cell
long_text.evidence: .odl-value { font: var(--ds-text-title-lg); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }
